mapper.select: select id, batch_no, merchant_id, period_start, period_end, total_amount, detail_count, success_count, failed_count, status, idempotency_key, reviewer_id, reviewed_at, create_time, update_time from settlement_batch where idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into settlement_batch (batch_no, merchant_id, period_start, period_end, total_amount, detail_count, success_count, failed_count, status, idempotency_key, create_time) values (#{batchNo}, #{merchantId}, #{periodStart}, #{periodEnd}, #{totalAmount}, #{detailCount}, #{successCount}, #{failedCount}, #{status}, #{idempotencyKey}, now())
mapper.select: select id, batch_no, merchant_id, period_start, period_end, total_amount, detail_count, success_count, failed_count, status, idempotency_key, reviewer_id, reviewed_at, create_time, update_time from settlement_batch where id = #{id} limit 1
mapper.update: update settlement_batch set status = #{status}, reviewer_id = #{reviewerId}, reviewed_at = #{reviewedAt}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and status = 0
mapper.select: select merchant_id, count(1) as batch_count, coalesce(sum(detail_count), 0) as detail_count, coalesce(sum(total_amount), 0) as total_amount, coalesce(sum(case when status = 0 then total_amount else 0 end), 0) as pending_amount from settlement_batch where merchant_id = #{merchantId} group by merchant_id
mapper.update: update settlement_batch set total_amount = #{totalAmount}, detail_count = #{detailCount}, update_time = now() where id = #{id}
mapper.sql: select b.id as batchId, b.merchant_id as merchantId, coalesce(b.total_amount, 0) as batchTotalAmount, coalesce(sum(d.settlement_amount), 0) as detailTotalAmount, coalesce(b.total_amount, 0) - coalesce(sum(d.settlement_amount), 0) as differenceAmount from settlement_batch b left join settlement_detail d on d.batch_id = b.id group by b.id, b.merchant_id, b.total_amount having coalesce(b.total_amount, 0) != coalesce(sum(d.settlement_amount), 0)
